name: Scarlet Watch Post
summary: In northeastern Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Watch Post guards the rocky hills just north of the Scarlet Monastery. Its garrison watches the monastery’s northern flank for attacks.

sections.title: Guarding the Northern Approach
sections.body: Scarlet Watch Post watches the northern cliffs behind the Scarlet Monastery. The southern road to the monastery gate is busy and fortified, but the rugged cliffs along Tirisfal’s northern coast offer infiltrators a back route. The Scarlet Crusade built this stone tower to guard that blind spot. It is one of several Crusader outposts scattered across Tirisfal Glades. Captain Melrache commands a mixed, devout force of Neophytes, Vanguards, and Friars. They keep watch over the cliffs so neither the Scourge nor the Forsaken can surprise the order from behind.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Scarlet Watch Post?
aliases: why is scarlet watch post here
faq.answer: Scarlet Watch Post protects the Scarlet Monastery from a northern flanking attack. The monastery’s rear slopes face the northern wilderness, where sentries watch for intruders and intercept anyone attempting a northern bypass.

faq.q: Who commands the Scarlet Watch Post?
faq.answer: Captain Melrache commands the garrison at the tower. His force includes personal bodyguards, front-line Vanguards, aspiring Neophytes, and spellcasting Friars.

faq.q: Is the Scarlet Watch Post related to the other towers in Tirisfal?
faq.answer: Yes. Scarlet Watch Post is one of four Crusader outposts across the northern and western reaches of Tirisfal Glades. Together, the stone towers form a defensive perimeter to monitor Scourge activity and contain the Forsaken’s expansion from the Undercity.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face the Scarlet Crusade near the Undercity. Attacking isolated towers like Scarlet Watch Post disrupts the zealots’ communications and helps secure northern Tirisfal.
As a member of the Horde, you’ll find Scarlet Watch Post hostile ground. The Crusaders see outsiders, living or dead, as tainted carriers of undeath.
